source: Ink/Stitch v3.3.0 installé (lecture des fichiers .inx et des définitions @param)

params.name: palette
params.label: *Choose color palette
options: Simthread glow in the dark / 15 colors
options_libelles: Simthread glow in the dark / 15 colors

params.name: text
params.label: Text
params.aide: Enter the text. Each line of text will be exported to a separate file.

params.name: separator
params.label: Custom separator
params.aide: Set a custom separator for multiline text export. Leave empty for line break.

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale (%)
params.aide: The scale value must be within the scale range of the specified font.

params.name: text-position
params.label: Horizontal text position
params.aide: Uses this text position when using lettering along path

params.name: vertical-text-position
params.label: Vertical text position
params.aide: Uses this text position when using lettering along path

params.name: file-formats
params.label: File formats
params.aide: Comma separated list of file formats

params.name: threshold
params.label: Threshold (px²)
params.aide: Removes shapes and holes smaller than this

params.name: rm_fill
params.label: Remove Small Fill Areas
params.aide: Removes areas smaller than defined by threshold.

params.name: rm_stroke
params.label: Remove Small strokes
params.aide: Removes small strokes shorter than defined by threshold.

params.name: rm_satin
params.label: Remove Small satins
params.aide: Removes small satin columns shorter than defined by threshold.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Test run
params.aide: Only display labels and ids of affected elements and groups without removing them.

params.name: num-neighbors-red
params.label: Number of stitches
params.aide: 0 = no density info

params.name: num-neighbors-yellow
params.label: Number of stitches
params.aide: 0 = no density info

params.name: skip_end_section
params.label: Start / end at rung
params.aide: Needs at least 2 rungs

params.name: keep
params.label: Keep (do not remove)
params.aide: Define which elements from the original selection will be removed after conversion.                                     Fills with no rung interesection are neither converted nor removed.

params.name: threshold_mm
params.label: Threshold for dead ends (mm)
params.aide: Deletes small lines. A good value in most cases is the approximate line width of the original shape

params.name: stop_position
params.label: Jump destination for Stop commands (a.k.a. "Frame Out position").

params.name: end-row-spacing
params.label: End row spacing
params.aide: Set to zero to use twice the row spacing value

params.name: install-palettes
params.label: Install thread color palettes
params.aide: Installs some default thread color palettes.

params.name: install-symbol-libraries
params.label: Install symbol libraries
params.aide: Installs symbol libraries with reusable motifs for embroidery

params.name: minimum-jump-length
params.label: Convert jumps longer than (mm)
params.aide: A value of 0 defaults to the actual minimum jump stitch length.

params.name: maximum-jump-length
params.label: Convert jumps shorter than (mm)
params.aide: A value of 0 means no size limit.

params.name: merge
params.label: Merge consecutive strokes of same type

params.name: simple-shape
params.label: Use only shape
params.aide: Whether or not the motif should be cut out of the shape.

params.name: ignore_layer
params.label: Ignore layer (do not stitch any objects in this layer)

params.name: distance
params.label: Add forced lock stitches by distance
params.aide: Add lock stitches when the following jump stitch is in the specified size range

params.name: last_element
params.label: Add forced lock stitches to the last element of each glyph

params.name: last_group_element
params.label: Add forced lock stitches to the last element of each group

params.name: default_variant
params.label: Default variant
params.aide: Default embroidery direction

params.name: auto-satin
params.label: Autoroute Satin
params.aide: Disable if you defined manual routing in your font.

params.name: scale-cross_stitch
params.label: Scale cross stitch pattern
params.aide: Wether or not the cross stitch pattern will be scaled along with the font.

params.name: reversible
params.label: Reversible
params.aide: If disabled back and forth stitching will not be possile for this font.

params.name: sortable
params.label: Sortable
params.aide: If disabled color sorting will be disabled for this font.                    Color sorting needs color_sort_index indicators within the font.

params.name: combine-at-sort-indices
params.label: Combine indices
params.aide: When color sorting, combine elements with this color indices (comma separated)

params.name: use-custom-leading
params.label: Force
params.aide: Overwrite leading information from font file.

params.name: leading
params.label: Leading (px)
params.aide: Line height (default: 100)

params.name: use-custom-spacing
params.label: Force
params.aide: Overwrite word spacing information from font file.

params.name: word-spacing
params.label: Word spacing (px)
params.aide: Space character width (default: 20)

params.name: use-custom-letter-spacing
params.label: Force
params.aide: Overwrite letter spacing information from font file.

params.name: letter-spacing
params.label: Letter spacing (px)
params.aide: Letter spacing (default: 100)

params.name: use-glyph-width
params.label: Use glyph width
params.aide: Use glyph width to define letter spacing.

params.name: action
params.label: Choose action
options_libelles: Step 1 : Comma and period and hyphen
Step 3 : Digits, Symbols  and Opening Punctuation

commandes.nom: Convert SVG Font to Glyph Layers

params.name: reference
params.label: Use this character to define size

params.name: margin-left
params.label: Margin left (mm)
params.aide: With "Use glyph width" enabled in the json, the margin to the left page border defines the distance between glyphs

params.name: stop
params.label: Stop (pause machine) after sewing this object

params.name: trim
params.label: Trim thread after sewing this object

params.name: satin_cut_point
params.label: Satin cut point (use with Cut Satin Column)

params.name: threshold
params.label: Threshold (mm²)
params.aide: Removes smaller shape areas than that

params.name: buffer
params.label: Buffer (mm)
params.aide: Enlarge strokes by this amount

params.name: smoothness
params.label: Smoothness (mm)
params.aide: Smooth path by this amount

params.name: inset
params.label: Inset (mm)
params.aide: Counteract the buffer effect

params.name: flip_x
params.label: negate X coordinate values
params.aide: Negate x coordinates

params.name: flip_y
params.label: negate Y coordinate values
params.aide: Negate y coordinates

params.name: alternate_z
params.label: Z coordinate value
params.aide: Either alternate Z value between 0 and 1 or travel custom value.

params.name: stitch_z_travel
params.label: Z travel per stitch
params.aide: increment z coordinate by this amount per stitch if "Z travel per stitch" is enabled

params.name: custom_stitch
params.label: STITCH
params.aide: Use '%X' for x-coordinate. Use '%Y' for y-coordinate and '%Z' for z-coordinate.

params.name: custom_color_change
params.label: COLOR CHANGE
params.aide: Leave empty to use default value. Use 'none' to remove. Use %R %G %B for thread color values

params.name: custom_jump
params.label: JUMP
params.aide: Leave empty to ignore jumps. Use '%X' for x-coordinate and '%Y' for y-coordinate.

params.name: custom_stop
params.label: STOP
params.aide: Leave empty to use default value. Use 'none' to remove.

params.name: custom_start
params.label: START
params.aide: Use %R %G %B for inital color thread color values

params.name: laser_mode
params.label: laser mode
params.aide: Laser mode (generate g-code for grbl laser mode)

params.name: dynamic_laser_power
params.label: dynamic laser power
params.aide: Use Grbl's M4 dynamic laser power mode.  Ensures consistent laser cutting power regardless of motor speed.  Only for PWM-capable lasers.

params.name: laser_warm_up_time
params.label: laser warm-up time
params.aide: When turning on the laser, wait this many seconds for laser to warm up (G4 command)

params.name: spindle_speed
params.label: spindle speed
params.aide: spindle speed (laser power for laser mode, set to -1 to omit)

params.name: min_spindle_speed
params.label: min spindle speed
params.aide: minimum spindle speed value (grbl $31 setting)

params.name: max_spindle_speed
params.label: max spindle speed
params.aide: minimum spindle speed value (grbl $30 setting)

params.name: feed_rate
params.label: feed rate (in mm/min, set to -1 to omit)

params.name: merge_distance
params.label: Connect lines below this distance (mm)
params.aide: Unconnected lines may result in jump stitches

params.name: minimum_path_length
params.label: Minimum path length (mm)
params.aide: Shorter paths  will be removed from redwork result

params.name: redwork_running_stitch_length_mm
params.label: Redwork stitch length (mm)
params.aide: set  redwork  stitch length

params.name: redwork_bean_stitch_repeats
params.label: Redwork bean stitch number of repeats
params.aide: Redwork bean stitch number of repeats

params.name: redwork_split_colors
params.label: Split by color
params.aide: Split strokes by colors and generate Redwork for each color.

params.name: combine
params.label: Combine elements
params.aide: Combine consecutive elements of same type

params.name: num_points
params.label: Remove point if repeated within this number of consecutive points

params.name: del_params
params.label: Remove Params
params.aide: Removes params from selected objects or all objects if nothing is selected.

params.name: del_commands
params.label: Remove Commands
params.aide: Removes visual commands from selected objects or all objects if nothing is selected.
options_libelles: Stop (pause machine) after sewing this object
Trim thread after sewing this object
Satin cut point (use with Cut Satin Column)
Ignore layer (do not stitch any objects in this layer)
Jump destination for Stop commands (a.k.a. "Frame Out position").

params.name: del_print
params.label: Remove Print Settings from SVG metadata

commandes.nom: Re-stack objects in order of selection

params.name: keep_satin
params.label: Keep satin column
params.aide: Do not delete original satin column.

params.name: running-stitch-condition
params.label: Type
params.aide: Select only specific running stitches

params.name: satin-underlay
params.label: Underlay
params.aide: Only select satins with this underlay type

params.name: rung-count
params.label: Rung count
params.aide: Only select satins with this rung count

params.name: fill-underlay
params.label: Underlay
params.aide: Only select fills with this underlay

params.name: render-mode
params.label: Render Mode
params.aide: Realistic modes will render to a raster image for performance reasons. Realistic Vector may cause Inkscape to slow down for complex designs.

params.name: move-to-side
params.label: Move stitch plan beside the canvas

params.name: insensitive
params.label: Lock
params.aide: Make stitch plan insensitive to mouse interactions

commandes.nom: Stroke to Live Path Effect Satin

params.name: show-errors
params.label: Errors
params.aide: Problems that will prevent the shape from being embroidered.

params.name: show-warnings
params.label: Warnings
params.aide: Problems that may lead to incorrect stitch paths.

params.name: show-type-warning
params.label: Object type warning
params.aide: Warns about unemboiderable object types.

params.name: custom-file-name
params.label: Custom file name
params.aide: Defines the file names inside the zip archive. Leave empty for default file name.

clone.name: angle
clone.label: Custom fill angle
clone.tooltip: This setting will apply a custom fill angle for the clone.

clone.name: flip_angle
clone.label: Flip angle
clone.tooltip: Flip automatically calculated angle if it appears to be wrong.

element.name: min_stitch_length_mm
element.label: Minimum stitch length
element.tooltip: Overwrite global minimum stitch length setting. Shorter stitches than that will be removed.

element.name: min_jump_stitch_length_mm
element.label: Minimum jump stitch length
element.tooltip: Overwrite global minimum jump stitch length setting. Shorter distances to the next object will have no lock stitches.

element.name: ties
element.label: Allow lock stitches
element.tooltip: Tie thread at the beginning and/or end of this object. Manual stitch will only add lock stitches if force lock stitched is checked.

element.name: force_lock_stitches
element.label: Force lock stitches
element.tooltip: Sew lock stitches after sewing this element, even if the distance to the next object is shorter than defined by the minimum jump stitch length value in the Ink/Stitch preferences.

element.name: lock_custom_start
element.label: Custom path
element.tooltip: Enter a custom path. For svg paths The last node will not be embroidered, but represents the first stitch of the element.

element.name: lock_custom_end
element.label: Custom path
element.tooltip: Enter a custom path. For svg paths the first node will not be embroidered, but represents the last stitch of the element.

element.name: trim_after
element.label: Trim After
element.tooltip: Add a TRIM command after stitching this object.

element.name: stop_after
element.label: Stop After
element.tooltip: Add a STOP command after stitching this object.

fill_stitch.name: guided_fill_strategy
fill_stitch.label: Guided Fill Strategy
fill_stitch.tooltip: Copy (the default) will fill the shape with shifted copies of the line. Parallel offset will ensure that each line is always a consistent distance from its neighbor. Sharp corners may be introduced.

fill_stitch.name: meander_scale_percent
fill_stitch.label: Meander pattern scale
fill_stitch.tooltip: Percentage to stretch or compress the meander pattern.  You can scale horizontally and vertically individually by giving two percentages separated by a space.

fill_stitch.name: clip
fill_stitch.label: Clip path
fill_stitch.tooltip: Constrain stitching to the shape.  Useful when smoothing and expand are used.

fill_stitch.name: smoothness_mm
fill_stitch.label: Smoothness
fill_stitch.tooltip: Smooth the stitch path.  Smoothness limits how far the smoothed stitch path is allowed to deviate from the original path.  Try low numbers like 0.2.  Hint: a lower running stitch tolerance may be needed too.

fill_stitch.name: expand_mm
fill_stitch.label: Expand
fill_stitch.tooltip: Expand the shape before fill stitching, to compensate for gaps between shapes.  Negative values contract instead.

fill_stitch.name: gap_fill_rows
fill_stitch.label: Gap Filling
fill_stitch.tooltip: Add extra rows to compensate for gaps between sections caused by distortion.Rows are always added in pairs, so this number will be rounded up to the nearest multiple of 2.

fill_stitch.name: angle
fill_stitch.label: Angle of lines of stitches
fill_stitch.tooltip: The angle increases in a counter-clockwise direction.  0 is horizontal.  Negative angles are allowed.

fill_stitch.name: guided_fill_angle
fill_stitch.label: Guide copy angle
fill_stitch.tooltip: Angle for guide line shifting. Changing the angle may have a huge impact on the actual spacing between the rows. Ensure the guide line is large enough to fill the area when shifted into the given angle.

fill_stitch.name: tartan_angle
fill_stitch.label: Angle of lines of stitches
fill_stitch.tooltip: Relative to the tartan stripe direction.

fill_stitch.name: max_stitch_length_mm
fill_stitch.label: Maximum fill stitch length
fill_stitch.tooltip: The length of each stitch in a row.  Shorter stitch may be used at the start or end of a row.

fill_stitch.name: row_spacing_mm
fill_stitch.label: Spacing between rows
fill_stitch.tooltip: Distance between rows of stitches.

fill_stitch.name: end_row_spacing_mm
fill_stitch.label: End row spacing
fill_stitch.tooltip: Increases or decreases the row spacing towards the end.

fill_stitch.name: stitch_position_method
fill_stitch.label: Stitch position method
fill_stitch.tooltip:
Flexible: adapts stitch lenghts accordingly to the tolerance value while keeping stitch length consistent on each curve segment.
Flexible (stagger): adapts stitch length accordingly to the tolerance value while also optimizing for stagger.

fill_stitch.name: staggers
fill_stitch.label: Stagger rows this many times before repeating
fill_stitch.tooltip: Length of the cycle by which successive stitch rows are staggered. Fractional values are allowed and can have less visible diagonals than integer values.

fill_stitch.name: skip_last
fill_stitch.label: Skip last stitch in each row
fill_stitch.tooltip: The last stitch in each row is quite close to the first stitch in the next row.  Skipping it decreases stitch count and density.

fill_stitch.name: flip
fill_stitch.label: Flip fill (start right-to-left)
fill_stitch.tooltip: The flip option can help you with routing your stitch path.  When you enable flip, stitching goes from right-to-left instead of left-to-right.

fill_stitch.name: reverse
fill_stitch.label: Reverse fill
fill_stitch.tooltip: Reverses fill path.

fill_stitch.name: stop_at_ending_point
fill_stitch.label: Stop at ending point
fill_stitch.tooltip: If this option is disabled, the ending point will only be used to define a general direction for stitch routing. When enabled the last section will end at the defined spot.

fill_stitch.name: underpath
fill_stitch.label: Underpath
fill_stitch.tooltip: Travel inside the shape when moving from section to section.  Underpath stitches avoid traveling in the direction of the row angle so that they are not visible.  This gives them a jagged appearance.

fill_stitch.name: running_stitch_length_mm
fill_stitch.label: Running stitch length
fill_stitch.tooltip: Length of stitches around the outline of the fill region used when moving from section to section. Also used for meander and circular fill.

fill_stitch.name: running_stitch_tolerance_mm
fill_stitch.label: Running stitch tolerance
fill_stitch.tooltip: Determines how hard Ink/Stitch tries to avoid stitching outside the shape.Lower numbers are less likely to stitch outside the shape but require more stitches.

fill_stitch.name: enable_random_stitch_length
fill_stitch.label: Randomize stitch length
fill_stitch.tooltip: Randomize stitch length and phase instead of dividing evenly or staggering. This is recommended for closely-spaced curved fills to avoid Moiré artefacts.

fill_stitch.name: random_stitch_length_jitter_percent
fill_stitch.label: Random stitch length jitter
fill_stitch.tooltip: Amount to vary the length of each stitch by when randomizing.

fill_stitch.name: repeats
fill_stitch.label: Repeats
fill_stitch.tooltip: Defines how many times to run down and back along the path.

fill_stitch.name: bean_stitch_repeats
fill_stitch.label: Bean stitch number of repeats
fill_stitch.tooltip:
Backtrack each stitch this many times.  A value of 1 would triple each stitch (forward, back, forward).  A value of 2 would quintuple each stitch, etc.

A pattern with various repeats can be created with a list of values separated by a space.

fill_stitch.name: zigzag_spacing_mm
fill_stitch.label: Zig-zag spacing (peak-to-peak)
fill_stitch.tooltip: Length of stitches in zig-zag mode.

fill_stitch.name: zigzag_width_mm
fill_stitch.label: Zig-zag width
fill_stitch.tooltip: Width of the zig-zag line.

fill_stitch.name: rows_per_thread
fill_stitch.label: Rows per tartan thread
fill_stitch.tooltip: Consecutive rows of the same color

fill_stitch.name: herringbone_width_mm
fill_stitch.label: Herringbone width
fill_stitch.tooltip: Defines width of a herringbone pattern. Use 0 for regular rows.

fill_stitch.name: pull_compensation_mm
fill_stitch.label: Pull compensation
fill_stitch.tooltip: Fill stitch can pull the fabric together, resulting in a shape narrower than you draw in Inkscape. This setting expands each row of stitches outward from the center of the row by a fixed length. Two values separated by a space may be used for an asymmetric effect.

fill_stitch.name: pull_compensation_percent
fill_stitch.label: Pull compensation percentage
fill_stitch.tooltip: Additional pull compensation which varies as a percentage of row width. Two values separated by a space may be used for an asymmetric effect.

fill_stitch.name: fill_underlay_angle
fill_stitch.label: Fill angle
fill_stitch.tooltip: Default: fill angle + 90 deg. Insert a list for multiple layers separated by a space.

fill_stitch.name: fill_underlay_row_spacing_mm
fill_stitch.label: Row spacing
fill_stitch.tooltip: default: 3x fill row spacing

fill_stitch.name: fill_underlay_max_stitch_length_mm
fill_stitch.label: Max stitch length
fill_stitch.tooltip: default: equal to fill max stitch length

fill_stitch.name: fill_underlay_inset_mm
fill_stitch.label: Inset
fill_stitch.tooltip: Shrink the shape before doing underlay, to prevent underlay from showing around the outside of the fill.

fill_stitch.name: fill_underlay_skip_last
fill_stitch.label: Skip last stitch in each row
fill_stitch.tooltip: The last stitch in each row is quite close to the first stitch in the next row.  Skipping it decreases stitch count and density.

fill_stitch.name: underlay_underpath
fill_stitch.label: Underpath
fill_stitch.tooltip: Travel inside the shape when moving from section to section.  Underpath stitches avoid traveling in the direction of the row angle so that they are not visible.  This gives them a jagged appearance.

fill_stitch.name: random_seed
fill_stitch.label: Random seed
fill_stitch.tooltip: Use a specific seed for randomized attributes. Uses the element ID if empty.

fill_stitch.name: cross_thread_count
fill_stitch.label: Thread count
fill_stitch.tooltip:
Defines the thread count for each stitch.
Thread count must be an even number.
Half crosses are stitched with an odd thread count.

fill_stitch.name: pattern_size_mm
fill_stitch.label: Pattern size
fill_stitch.tooltip: Cross stitch pattern size in mm, x and y values are separated by a space. Only one input value returns a square pattern.

fill_stitch.name: canvas_grid_origin
fill_stitch.label: Align grid with canvas
fill_stitch.tooltip:
This ensures good alignment for adjacent cross stitch areas, but it also means that the outcome may change when the element is moved off the grid.

Disable this option to ensure, that this element stitches the same, independently on its position on the canvas.

fill_stitch.name: cross_offset_mm
fill_stitch.label: Grid Offset
fill_stitch.tooltip: Shifts the cross stitch grid by given values. X and Y values are separated by a space. Only one input value offsets the pattern evenly for x and y.

fill_stitch.name: cross_rotation
fill_stitch.label: Grid Rotation
fill_stitch.tooltip: Rotates the cross stitch grid by the given value.

fill_stitch.name: fill_coverage
fill_stitch.label: Fill coverage
fill_stitch.tooltip: Percentage of overlap for each cross with the fill area

fill_stitch.name: max_cross_stitch_length_mm
fill_stitch.label: Maximum stitch length
fill_stitch.tooltip: The length of each stitch in a row.  Shorter stitch may be used at the start or end of a row.

satin_column.name: random_width_decrease_percent
satin_column.label: Random percentage of satin width decrease
satin_column.tooltip: shorten stitch across rails at most this percent. Two values separated by a space may be used for an asymmetric effect.

satin_column.name: random_width_increase_percent
satin_column.label: Random percentage of satin width increase
satin_column.tooltip: lengthen stitch across rails at most this percent. Two values separated by a space may be used for an asymmetric effect.

satin_column.name: random_zigzag_spacing_percent
satin_column.label: Random zig-zag spacing percentage
satin_column.tooltip: Amount of random jitter added to zigzag spacing.

satin_column.name: split_method
satin_column.label: Split Method
satin_column.tooltip: Display needle penetration points in simulator to see the effect of each split method.

satin_column.name: max_stitch_length_mm
satin_column.label: Maximum stitch length
satin_column.tooltip: Maximum stitch length for split stitches.

satin_column.name: random_split_jitter_percent
satin_column.label: Random jitter for split stitches
satin_column.tooltip: Randomizes split stitch length if random phase is enabled, stitch position if disabled.

satin_column.name: random_split_phase
satin_column.label: Random phase for split stitches
satin_column.tooltip: Controls whether split stitches are centered or with a random phase (which may increase stitch count).

satin_column.name: min_random_split_length_mm
satin_column.label: Minimum length for random-phase split
satin_column.tooltip: Defaults to maximum stitch length. Smaller values allow for a transition between single-stitch and split-stitch.

satin_column.name: split_staggers
satin_column.label: Stagger split stitches this many times before repeating
satin_column.tooltip: Length of the cycle by which successive stitch rows are staggered. Fractional values are allowed and can have less visible diagonals than integer values.

satin_column.name: short_stitch_inset
satin_column.label: Short stitch inset
satin_column.tooltip: Stitches in areas with high density will be inset by this amount.Two values separated by a space define inset levels if there are multiple consecutive short stitches.

satin_column.name: short_stitch_distance_mm
satin_column.label: Short stitch distance
satin_column.tooltip: Inset stitches if the distance between stitches is smaller than this.

satin_column.name: zigzag_spacing_mm
satin_column.label: Zig-zag spacing (peak-to-peak)
satin_column.tooltip: Peak-to-peak distance between zig-zags. This is double the mm/stitch measurement used by most mechanical machines.

satin_column.name: pull_compensation_percent
satin_column.label: Pull compensation percentage
satin_column.tooltip: Additional pull compensation which varies as a percentage of stitch width. Two values separated by a space may be used for an asymmetric effect.

satin_column.name: pull_compensation_mm
satin_column.label: Pull compensation
satin_column.tooltip: Satin stitches pull the fabric together, resulting in a column narrower than you draw in Inkscape. This setting expands each pair of needle penetrations outward from the center of the satin column by a fixed length. Two values separated by a space may be used for an asymmetric effect.

satin_column.name: push_compensation_mm
satin_column.label: Push compensation
satin_column.tooltip: Shrinks the column at start and/or end.

satin_column.name: reverse_rails
satin_column.label: Reverse rails
satin_column.tooltip: This may help if your satin renders very strangely.  Default: automatically detect and fix a reversed rail.

satin_column.name: swap_satin_rails
satin_column.label: Swap rails
satin_column.tooltip: Swaps the first and second rails of the satin column, affecting which side the thread finished on as well as any sided properties

satin_column.name: running_stitch_length_mm
satin_column.label: Running stitch length
satin_column.tooltip: Length of stitches for start and end point connections.

satin_column.name: running_stitch_tolerance_mm
satin_column.label: Running stitch tolerance
satin_column.tooltip: Determines how hard Ink/Stitch tries to avoid stitching outside the shape.Lower numbers are less likely to stitch outside the shape but require more stitches.

satin_column.name: running_stitch_position
satin_column.label: Running Stitch Position
satin_column.tooltip: Position of running stitches between the rails. 0% is along the first rail, 50% is centered, 100% is along the second rail.

satin_column.name: start_at_nearest_point
satin_column.label: Start at nearest point
satin_column.tooltip: Start at nearest point to previous element. A start position command will overwrite this setting.

satin_column.name: end_at_nearest_point
satin_column.label: End at nearest point
satin_column.tooltip: End at nearest point to the next element. An end position command will overwrite this setting.

satin_column.name: contour_underlay_stitch_tolerance_mm
satin_column.label: Stitch tolerance
satin_column.tooltip: All stitches must be within this distance from the path. A lower tolerance means stitches will be closer together. A higher tolerance means sharp corners may be rounded.

satin_column.name: contour_underlay_inset_mm
satin_column.label: Inset distance (fixed)
satin_column.tooltip: Shrink the outline by a fixed length, to prevent the underlay from showing around the outside of the satin column.

satin_column.name: contour_underlay_inset_percent
satin_column.label: Inset distance (proportional)
satin_column.tooltip: Shrink the outline by a proportion of the column width, to prevent the underlay from showing around the outside of the satin column.

satin_column.name: center_walk_underlay_stitch_tolerance_mm
satin_column.label: Stitch tolerance
satin_column.tooltip: All stitches must be within this distance from the path. A lower tolerance means stitches will be closer together. A higher tolerance means sharp corners may be rounded. Defaults to stitch length.

satin_column.name: center_walk_underlay_repeats
satin_column.label: Repeats
satin_column.tooltip: For an odd number of repeats, this will reverse the direction the satin column is stitched, causing stitching to both begin and end at the start point.

satin_column.name: center_walk_underlay_position
satin_column.label: Position
satin_column.tooltip: Position of underlay from between the rails. 0% is along the first rail, 50% is centered, 100% is along the second rail.

satin_column.name: zigzag_underlay_spacing_mm
satin_column.label: Zig-Zag spacing (peak-to-peak)
satin_column.tooltip: Distance between peaks of the zig-zags.

satin_column.name: zigzag_underlay_inset_mm
satin_column.label: Inset amount (fixed)
satin_column.tooltip: default: half of contour underlay inset

satin_column.name: zigzag_underlay_inset_percent
satin_column.label: Inset amount (proportional)
satin_column.tooltip: default: half of contour underlay inset

satin_column.name: zigzag_underlay_max_stitch_length_mm
satin_column.label: Maximum stitch length
satin_column.tooltip: Split stitch if distance of maximum stitch length is exceeded

satin_column.name: random_seed
satin_column.label: Random seed
satin_column.tooltip: Use a specific seed for randomized attributes. Uses the element ID if empty.

stroke.name: repeats
stroke.label: Repeats
stroke.tooltip: Defines how many times to run down and back along the path.

stroke.name: bean_stitch_repeats
stroke.label: Bean stitch number of repeats
stroke.tooltip:
Backtrack each stitch this many times.  A value of 1 would triple each stitch (forward, back, forward).  A value of 2 would quintuple each stitch, etc.

A pattern with various repeats can be created with a list of values separated by a space.

stroke.name: manual_pattern_placement
stroke.label: Manual stitch placement
stroke.tooltip: No extra stitches will be added to the original ripple pattern and the running stitch length value will be ignored.

stroke.name: running_stitch_length_mm
stroke.label: Running stitch length
stroke.tooltip:
Length of stitches. Stitches can be shorter according to the stitch tolerance setting.
It is possible to create stitch length patterns by adding multiple values separately.

stroke.name: running_stitch_tolerance_mm
stroke.label: Stitch tolerance
stroke.tooltip: All stitches must be within this distance from the path.  A lower tolerance means stitches will be closer together.  A higher tolerance means sharp corners may be rounded.

stroke.name: enable_random_stitch_length
stroke.label: Randomize stitch length
stroke.tooltip: Randomize stitch length and phase instead of dividing evenly or staggering. This is recommended for closely-spaced curved fills to avoid Moiré artefacts.

stroke.name: random_stitch_length_jitter_percent
stroke.label: Random stitch length jitter
stroke.tooltip: Amount to vary the length of each stitch by when randomizing.

stroke.name: max_stitch_length_mm
stroke.label: Max stitch length
stroke.tooltip: Split stitches longer than this.

stroke.name: zigzag_spacing_mm
stroke.label: Zig-zag spacing (peak-to-peak)
stroke.tooltip: Length of stitches in zig-zag mode.

stroke.name: stroke_pull_compensation_mm
stroke.label: Pull compensation
stroke.tooltip: Zigzag stitches pull the fabric together, resulting in a column narrower than you draw in Inkscape. This widens the zigzag line width.

stroke.name: zigzag_angle
stroke.label: Zig-zag angle
stroke.tooltip: Rotate zig-zag direction by this angle (degrees). Creates spoke/radial effects on curves.

stroke.name: line_count
stroke.label: Number of lines
stroke.tooltip: Number of lines from start to finish

stroke.name: min_line_dist_mm
stroke.label: Minimum line distance
stroke.tooltip: Overrides the number of lines setting.

stroke.name: satin_guide_pattern_position
stroke.label: Pattern position
stroke.tooltip: Pattern position for satin guided ripples.

stroke.name: staggers
stroke.label: Stagger lines this many times before repeating
stroke.tooltip: Length of the cycle by which successive stitch lines are staggered. Fractional values are allowed and can have less visible diagonals than integer values. A value of 0 (default) disables staggering and instead stitches evenly.For linear ripples only.

stroke.name: skip_start
stroke.label: Skip first lines
stroke.tooltip: Skip this number of lines at the beginning.

stroke.name: skip_end
stroke.label: Skip last lines
stroke.tooltip: Skip this number of lines at the end

stroke.name: flip_copies
stroke.label: Flip every second line
stroke.tooltip: Linear ripple: wether to flip the pattern every second line or not.

stroke.name: exponent
stroke.label: Line distance exponent
stroke.tooltip: Increase density towards one side.

stroke.name: flip_exponent
stroke.label: Flip exponent
stroke.tooltip: Reverse exponent effect.

stroke.name: reverse
stroke.label: Reverse
stroke.tooltip: Flip start and end point

stroke.name: reverse_rails
stroke.label: Reverse rails
stroke.tooltip: Reverse satin ripple rails. Default: automatically detect and fix a reversed rail.

stroke.name: swap_satin_rails
stroke.label: Swap rails
stroke.tooltip: Swaps the first and second rails of a satin ripple, affecting which side the thread finished on as well as any sided properties

stroke.name: grid_size_mm
stroke.label: Grid size
stroke.tooltip: Render as grid. Use with care and watch your stitch density.

stroke.name: grid_first
stroke.label: Stitch grid first
stroke.tooltip: Reverse the stitch paths, so that the grid will be stitched first

stroke.name: scale_axis
stroke.label: Scale axis
stroke.tooltip: Scale axis for satin guided ripple stitches.

stroke.name: scale_start
stroke.label: Starting scale
stroke.tooltip: How big the first copy of the line should be, in percent. +   + Used only for ripple stitch with a guide line.

stroke.name: scale_end
stroke.label: Ending scale
stroke.tooltip: How big the last copy of the line should be, in percent. +   + Used only for ripple stitch with a guide line.

stroke.name: rotate_ripples
stroke.label: Rotate
stroke.tooltip: Rotate satin guided ripple stitches

stroke.name: join_style
stroke.label: Join style
stroke.tooltip: Join style for non circular ripples.

stroke.name: random_seed
stroke.label: Random seed
stroke.tooltip: Use a specific seed for randomized attributes. Uses the element ID if empty.
